display_name: White ceramic mug with visible lower-left handle for overhead scenes

design.geometry: compact circular body with a thin readable rim, gently rounded wall and one complete handle visible near the seven-to-eight-o'clock direction in the overhead view

allowed_transfer: one complete handle that remains visible from overhead
thin rim and plain unbranded exterior
forbidden_transfer: reference coffee color, latte art, crema, bubbles, recipe or topping
source beverage streaks, syrup bands, fruit color or transparency on the opaque mug exterior or base
reference text, logo, watermark or decorative mark
reference table edge, floor grout, environmental shadow silhouette or exact coordinates

compatibility.brand_surface: plain exterior only; apply branding only when a separately verified target brand contract authorizes it
